body:
**Binaries and packages will be attached soon**

- Add `apachectl` command parser
- Add `ics` file parser
- Add `conntrack` command parser
- Add `nfsiostat` command parser
- Add `nfsiostat-s` streaming command parser
- Add `nftables` `nft` command parser
- Fix `cksum` parser for lines with no filename
- Fix `crontab` and `crontab_u` parsers to ignore whitespace-only lines
- Fix `dpkg` parser for Unicode table header
- Fix `fstab` parser to ignore whitespace-only lines
- Fix `group` parser to ignore whitespace-only lines
- Fix `gshadow` parser to ignore whitespace-only lines
- Fix `ipconfig` parser to not warn for incompatibility on Windows
- Fix `lsattr` parser to support e2fsprogs and support `x` and `m` flags
- Fix `passwd` parser to ignore whitespace-only lines
- Fix `plist` parser for deprecation warning for codecs.open()
- Fix `shadow` parser to ignore whitespace-only lines
- Binary builds for linux and macOS (x86_64 and ARM) now include the
  python 3.14 runtime. Those executable files are now significantly smaller.
  Windows builds still use python 3.10 runtime
name: JC version 1.26.1
